rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
Welcome to your next course! ✨This course is about preparing your child for success in school by helping them learn. 

These skills are a guide: use them as your child is ready for them. 💡

This first skill is about helping your child learn new words and improve their language skills! 👂
rows.text_2::eng: Learning to talk and have conversations is important to help your child get ready to read and do well for school. 🎓

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: True or False: All children, no matter how they are growing, can learn and develop skills.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng:
✨You’re right! 

🎉 All children, no matter how they are growing, can learn and develop skills. 

🔑 Every child is different. They learn at different speeds, and what they can do changes with their age.
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng:
❌ That’s incorrect! 

🎉 All children, no matter how they are growing, can learn and develop skills. 

🔑 Every child is different. They learn at different speeds, and what they can do changes with their age.
rows.quiz_2_question::eng: True or False: It's okay if you do most of the talking when you have a conversation with your child.
rows.quiz_2_feedback_1::eng:
❌ That’s incorrect! 

🎈 Children learn new words and build confidence in their language abilities when they actively participate in the conversation. 

🌷 Children may not know how to say many words, but it’s important to continue encouraging them!
rows.quiz_2_feedback_2::eng:
⭐ That’s correct! 

🎈 Children learn new words and build confidence in their language abilities when they actively participate in the conversation. 

🌷 Children may not know how to say many words, but it’s important to continue encouraging them!

rows.text_1_facilitator::eng:
5️⃣ Here are 5 tips on helping your child learn by talking with them. 

💙 Talk with your child as often as you can! Go down to your child’s level by kneeling or squatting so you can make eye contact when talking to them.
😃 This will improve your relationship with them as well as their behaviour, because they will understand more of what you say.

rows.section_1_text::eng:
😃 You can talk by describing and explaining what you are doing. For example, chat with them while shopping at the market. 🍅
👂 Ask your child questions and listen to their answers!
⏯️ Give your child learning opportunities at their own pace. When they have tasks that suit their abilities, it will boost their excitement for learning. 😃
rows.section_2_text::eng:
💡 Ask questions that don’t have just ‘yes’ or ‘no’ answers.
✨ Ask questions like, “What would you like to do with your friend later?” or, “What fun thing did you do in school today?”
rows.section_3_text::eng:
👂 Let your child speak too.
⏰ Give them time to respond - they may need time to think and express, especially if they are giving longer answers!
😃 After giving them time, if it is difficult for them to say what they want, you can help them with prompts!
rows.section_4_text::eng:
👂Listen to your child and always respond. 
🔄 Confirm what they said and add more to help them connect their understanding to new language. For example, if your child says, “There’s a cat,” you could respond, “Yes, there’s a cat making a big hole in the ground”.
rows.section_5_text::eng:
🎈 Tell your child stories! They can be real, made up, about your lives, or read to them from books.
😃 Encourage your child to tell stories too. You could show photos and create a story together!
🔄 Be patient! It takes lots of practice to listen to stories, and even more to learn the skill of telling them. 💙

rows.quiz_1_question::eng: Here is today’s home activity! Try to use words and gestures to describe your activities when spending time together. Make sure you communicate in a way that your child can understand. Can you do it today? ⭐
rows.quiz_1_feedback_1::eng: Excellent! Using words and gestures that your child can understand to describe your activities is a great way to help them learn! 💡
rows.quiz_1_feedback_2::eng: That’s okay. Try to find a time to talk to them, even if it’s just explaining something you’re doing around the house! 💡
